Description: The chapter mentions Katniss being outside of District 12, which contradicts the previous chapter summary indicating she was in District 12 dealing with the aftermath of Gale's whipping.
Gale's reaction to the uprising in District 8 seems inconsistent with his previous willingness to run away with Katniss.
Katniss's mother is described as having a 'disgusted grin' when looking at her daughters, which contradicts her usual caring demeanor.
The chapter refers to Katniss's prep team being imprisoned and mistreated in District 13, which contradicts the previous chapter summary where Katniss discovers them imprisoned for the first time.
The chapter refers to Katniss waking up in her old bed in the hospital, but previous summaries indicate she is in District 13, which has different living conditions.
The chapter mentions Katniss's father being killed in the mines, but previous summaries do not establish this fact.
The chapter mentions Peeta's leg injury affecting his ability to climb, but does not explain how he managed to walk back to the cave without significant difficulty.
